name: Netmend Chat PDF
title: Chat with any PDF: ask questions, get answers with page numbers
desc: Upload a PDF and ask questions about it: contracts, papers, manuals, reports. Answers cite page numbers. Free in your browser with your own Gemini key; the file never touches a Netmend server.
h1: Ask your PDF anything, get the page number
intro: Drop in a contract, a paper, a manual or a long report and ask questions in plain language. Netmend Chat PDF answers from the document and tells you which page it found it on.
